metadata.question: On January 23, 2025 at 1:44 pm, did the smoke plume from the Baja California fire (El Escondido area of Ensenada) extend less than 50 km westward over the Pacific Ocean?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Sensor: GOES-West visible/IR to capture smoke at the specific time. Try NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPF first (GOES-18 Full Disk), then fallback to GOES-17/16 MCMIPF.
- Time: ±60 minutes around 2025-01-23T21:44:00Z (13:44 PST).
- Location: West of Ensenada, Baja California. Narrow ocean strip west of coast near Ensenada to limit glint/false positives.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- We want smoke, not cold clouds. Use C14 (11 µm) BT > 285 K to exclude cold clouds.
- Use C02 (0.64 µm) reflectance threshold based on 80th percentile over the local ocean strip to capture bright smoke above ocean background.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection empty after all fallbacks: C1.
- If valid pixels after masking = 0: C2.
- If computed max distance is null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare max offshore distance to 50 km for A/B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to promisify getInfo
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const target = ee.Date('2025-01-23T21:44:00Z'); // 13:44 PST
  const start = target.advance(-60, 'minute');
  const end = target.advance(60, 'minute');

  // Ensenada center (approx)
  const cen = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.62, 31.86]);
  // Westward strip AOI: ~100 km west, ~50 km N-S
  const westStrip = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({
    coords: [-117.7, 31.61, -116.50, 32.11], // lon min, lat min, lon max, lat max
    geodesic: true
  });

  // Land geometry (Mexico + USA) for coastline and ocean mask
  const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
    .filter(ee.Filter.inList('country_na', ['Mexico', 'United States of America']));
  const landGeom = countries.geometry().buffer(1000); // small buffer to ensure coastline coverage
  const oceanRegion = westStrip.difference(landGeom, 1); // ocean-only in the strip

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallbacks
  const datasetIds = ['NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPF', 'NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPF', 'NOAA/GOES/16/MCMIPF'];
  let picked = null;
  let usedId = null;
  let windowCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < datasetIds.length; i++) {
    const id = datasetIds[i];
    try {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(id)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(cen)
        .select(['CMI_C02', 'CMI_C01', 'CMI_C14']); // red, blue, BT
      const sz = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (sz > 0) {
        // pick image closest to target time
        const withDelta = col.map(img => {
          const t = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start'));
          const delta = t.difference(target, 'minute').abs();
          return img.set('tdiff', delta);
        });
        const img = ee.Image(withDelta.sort('tdiff').first());
        picked = img;
        usedId = id;
        windowCount = sz;
        break;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(`Dataset error: ${id}`);
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
  }

  if (!picked) {
    console.log(`GOES images in window: 0`);
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  const pickedTime = ee.Date(picked.get('system:time_start'));
  const tdiffMin = ee.Number(picked.get('tdiff'));
  const pickedTimeStr = await getInfoAsync(pickedTime.format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'));
  const tdiffVal = await getInfoAsync(tdiffMin);

  // 3. Processing: create smoke mask over ocean using adaptive threshold and warm BT
  const red = picked.select('CMI_C02'); // reflectance
  const blue = picked.select('CMI_C01');
  const bt = picked.select('CMI_C14'); // brightness temperature (K)

  // Compute adaptive threshold for red reflectance over ocean region
  const percentiles = await getInfoAsync(
    red.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.percentile([60, 80, 95]),
      geometry: oceanRegion,
      scale: 2000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  let thr = 0.2;
  if (percentiles && percentiles.CMI_C02_p80 != null) {
    thr = Math.max(0.1, Math.min(0.9, percentiles.CMI_C02_p80));
  }

  // Build smoke candidate: bright in red, warm (exclude cold clouds), and moderately gray (blue close to red)
  const grayCond = blue.divide(red).gt(0.85); // suppress pure-glint cases somewhat
  const smokeMask = red.gt(thr).and(bt.gt(285)).and(grayCond).selfMask();

  // Count pixels
  const oceanOnes = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(ee.Image.constant(1)).clip(oceanRegion);
  const oceanCount = await getInfoAsync(
    oceanOnes.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: oceanRegion,
      scale: 2000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const oceanPix = oceanCount ? (oceanCount.constant || oceanCount.band || Object.values(oceanCount)[0]) : 0;

  const smokeCount = await getInfoAsync(
    smokeMask.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: oceanRegion,
      scale: 2000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const smokePix = smokeCount ? (smokeCount.CMI_C02 || smokeCount.constant || Object.values(smokeCount)[0]) : 0;

  if (!smokePix || smokePix === 0) {
    console.log(`Source: ${usedId}, window imgs: ${windowCount}`);
    console.log(`Picked: ${pickedTimeStr} (Δmin=${tdiffVal})`);
    console.log(`Ocean px: ${oceanPix}, Smoke px: 0, Thr(C02): ${thr.toFixed ? thr.toFixed(2) : thr}`);
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Calculation: maximum offshore distance (km) of smoke pixels west of coast
  // Distance to land (meters)
  const landRaster = ee.Image.constant(1).clip(landGeom);
  const distToLand = landRaster.distance(1000).rename('dist'); // meters

  const offshoreDist = distToLand.updateMask(smokeMask).clip(oceanRegion);
  const maxDistDict = await getInfoAsync(
    offshoreDist.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
      geometry: oceanRegion,
      scale: 2000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const maxDist = maxDistDict ? (maxDistDict.dist || Object.values(maxDistDict)[0]) : null;

  if (maxDist === null || maxDist === undefined || isNaN(maxDist)) {
    console.log(`Source: ${usedId}, window imgs: ${windowCount}`);
    console.log(`Picked: ${pickedTimeStr} (Δmin=${tdiffVal})`);
    console.log(`Ocean px: ${oceanPix}, Smoke px: ${smokePix}, Thr(C02): ${thr.toFixed ? thr.toFixed(2) : thr}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  const maxKm = maxDist / 1000.0;

  // 5. Validation & Final Answer
  console.log(`Source: ${usedId}, window imgs: ${windowCount}`);
  console.log(`Picked: ${pickedTimeStr} (Δmin=${tdiffVal})`);
  console.log(`Ocean px: ${oceanPix}, Smoke px: ${smokePix}, Thr(C02): ${thr.toFixed ? thr.toFixed(2) : thr}`);
  console.log(`Max offshore distance (km): ${maxKm.toFixed(1)}`);
  if (maxKm < 50) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
